dedupe_keys.name: high resolution facies correlation and climatostratigraphic studies of the drinking and irrigation water aquifer in the dong er catchment area hungary

description: High-resolution Facies correlation and Climatostratigraphic Studies of the drinking and irrigation Water Aquifer in the Dong-ér catchment Area, Hungary is a dataset listed in EGDI Metadata Catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by hugeo.hu. Zoltán Püspöki, Gábor Markos 2019: In order to establish hydrodynamic and transport modelling of the drinking and irrigation aquifers, we aimed at a high-resolution stratigraphic delineation of the Quaternary river water aquifer series, which is difficult to separate from the bedrock. Coverage: Europe. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://services.cuzk.gov.cz/registry/codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/authorizedUsers). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geology-cz.
